svg.title: Derivative signs explain a cubic curve rising, falling and rising
svg.desc: For f equals x cubed minus three x, the derivative is three times x minus one times x plus one. It is positive for x less than negative one, negative between negative one and one, and positive for x greater than one. The derivative is zero at negative one and one. The curve has a local maximum at negative one two and a local minimum at one negative two. The plotted increasing and decreasing sections match the sign chart.
